rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Built by Algovate using TypeScript and Puppeteer, this server provides browser automation capabilities for XiaoHongShu, China's popular social media platform. It offers 8 tools covering authentication (login/logout/status), content discovery (feed browsing, keyword search, note details), social interaction (commenting), and content publishing (both images and videos with up to 18 media files per post). The implementation handles XiaoHongShu's unique authentication flow including QR code scanning, manages session cookies automatically, and supports both stdio and HTTP transports with proper rate limiting and error handling. It respects platform-specific constraints like 20-character title limits and 1000-character content limits, making it valuable for social media managers, content creators, and marketers who need to automate XiaoHongShu operations.
